---
title: "LIQPLAT CONSORT participant flow"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Participant flow uses one anonymous row per candidate from the seven-column
V4 CONSORT export. Screening reasons and invitation outcomes are taken directly
from the export, without inferring them from missing acceptance values.

```{r}
#| label: consort-setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "consort-helpers.R"))
consort_data <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("data", "private", "consort_ipd.parquet"))
accounting <- consort_accounting(consort_data)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "01-population", "results")
figure_dir <- file.path(result_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
arrow::write_parquet(accounting, file.path(result_dir, "consort-accounting.parquet"))
consort_plot <- plot_consort(accounting)
for (extension in c("svg", "pdf", "png")) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0("consort-flow.", extension)),
    consort_plot, width = 11, height = 14, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-consort-flow
#| fig-cap: "LIQPLAT participant flow. Patients considered for a competing trial or after the weekly limit of three SAT invitations has been reached are not screened. Among eligible candidates, random selection determines who is invited to the SAT (offered ctDNA); those not selected receive usual care. Selected candidates must subsequently be approached and may accept or decline. Invitation outcomes do not change randomized allocation or ITT membership."
#| fig-alt: "Candidate flow through screening, eligibility and random allocation, with invitation outcomes only for the SAT arm. Exact counts appear in the accounting table below."
#| out-width: 100%

knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figure_dir, "consort-flow.png"))
```

Not-screened reasons are separate from clinical exclusions, which use the first
applicable reason in the exported hierarchy. Eligible candidates without an
allocation remain visible. Not approached is distinct from approached with a
missing decision. Missing SAT invitation status is shown explicitly when present;
no invitation process is imputed for usual-care candidates.

```{r}
#| label: consort-source-discrepancy
#| results: asis

conflicting_eligibility <- sum(consort_data$qualified_for_random_selection == 1 &
                               !is.na(consort_data$exclusion_reason))
if (conflicting_eligibility > 0) {
  cat(sprintf(paste0("**Source-data discrepancy:** %s candidates are marked eligible ",
    "but also carry an exclusion reason. The explicit qualification field takes ",
    "precedence: they remain in the eligible branch and are not counted again ",
    "as clinical exclusions. These source records require reconciliation.\n"),
    conflicting_eligibility))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-consort-accounting
#| tbl-cap: "Participant accounting, including parent denominators and proportions."

accounting |>
  transform(proportion = round(proportion, 4)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
